name: Jet
source:
The first person to reach out to the protagonist when she arrives in the other world. He seems kind but has an elusive personality. He teaches the protagonist the rules of that place and acts as her companion. He gives the impression of being somewhat cat-like.  

"I'm sorry for making you wait. My name is Jet. Pleased to meet you."

[Adapted from [url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]official website[/url]]
